per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall present a consistent UI layout and style across all screens to minimize user errors.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All screens created as part of the Disputes application must comply with corporate standards for interface creation.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall use clear visual cues, such as color coding, to distinguish case status (e.g., urgent, resolved).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The list of dispute cases that are displayed after a search is performed must be color coded for easy identification of dispute cases based upon the dispute case status.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure snappy response times for small actions (e.g., searches, case details) to minimize user frustration.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall integrate reliably with backend systems (e.g., statement system, cardmember/merchant data) to ensure data consistency.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide clear error messages and actionable feedback for failures (e.g., transaction mismatches, print utility errors).
The system shall enforce role-based access control to ensure that only authorized users can access specific case data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes System must prevent users from accessing any dispute cases that do not belong to their cardholder base.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be available 24/7 with minimal downtime, except during planned maintenance windows.
